$comment: HUD portraits (32x32 busts) built from each sprite's first idle frame by scripts/art/build-portraits.ts. 'tone' picks the backdrop: party (warm), foe (blood red), undead (cold), neutral. Build with `npm run art`. 'hand' holds the 48x48 busts of the party, painted from shapes by scripts/art/portrait-painter.ts; they replace the generated ones.
